note: Demo data — fictional. Every brand, number, and event in this file is invented for product demonstration. No real customer data.

signal.headline: 41,200 high-value customers are drifting toward lapse before festive season
signal.detail: Purchase gaps in the top spend decile stretched from 34 to 51 days. Festive season starts in 6 weeks — the window to re-engage is now.

plan.goal: Win back our top-decile customers before festive season without giving away margin.

steps.what: Split the 41,200 drifting customers into 3 cohorts by lapse risk and category affinity
Configure early-access festive previews for high-risk cohort; points multipliers for the rest
Monitor weekly repeat rate and ATV erosion; recalibrate offers per cycle

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: discounts above 15% need approval — 2 of 3 campaigns use none.

auto.action: Audience sync to campaign manager — 41,200 profiles
Points multiplier configured in loyalty engine

gated.action: Early-access preview implies a 20% member price advantage

actions: Purchase gap: 51 → 39 days in top decile
ATV held flat while repeat rate recovered
outcome.lift: Top-decile repeat rate +5.9pp — with discounts on just one of three campaigns.

signal.headline: Basket size in the North region fell 9.2% while trips held steady
signal.detail: Customers still visit weekly but skip mid-basket categories — household and personal care are down 17% among loyalty members.

plan.goal: Rebuild basket size in the North without blanket discounting.

steps.what: Identify 96K members who dropped household categories but kept fresh
Configure targeted cross-category rewards — buy fresh, earn on household
Track basket recomposition weekly; expand to other regions if lift > 4%

campaigns.name: Full Basket Bonus
campaigns.offer: 3× points on household with fresh purchase

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: regional offers above ₹40L projected spend need sign-off.

auto.action: Cohort of 96,000 synced to offer engine
Points accrual rule staged in loyalty engine

gated.action: Full Basket Bonus projects ₹52L in points liability

actions: Household category recovered 11 of 17 lost points
Program expanded to 2 more regions at week 4
outcome.lift: North-region baskets +7.1% — points cost came in 18% under the approved liability cap.

signal.headline: Lunch-daypart orders are down 12% among app users in metro outlets
signal.detail: Dinner is stable. The drop is concentrated in 88 metro outlets and correlates with two competitor lunch-combo launches.

plan.goal: Defend the lunch daypart in metro outlets this month.

steps.what: Flag 132K app users whose lunch frequency dropped but dinner held
Configure a time-boxed lunch combo upgrade, 11:30–14:00 only
Watch daypart mix daily; kill the offer if dinner cannibalization > 3%

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: offers touching more than 100K customers need approval.

auto.action: Daypart trigger rules configured at POS
Cannibalization guardrail armed at 3%

gated.action: Lunch Rush Combo will push to 132,000 app users

actions: Dinner cannibalization stayed at 1.1% — guardrail never fired
61 of 88 outlets recovered to baseline
outcome.lift: Metro lunch daypart recovered 9.4% — dinner untouched.

signal.headline: Checkout abandonment in electronics jumped 5.4pp after the payment flow update
signal.detail: The spike began the day the new payment flow shipped. High-ticket carts above ₹15K abandon at nearly twice the prior rate.

plan.goal: Recover abandoning electronics buyers while the payment flow gets fixed.

steps.what: Segment 58K abandoners by cart value and payment step reached
Configure recovery journeys — hold-the-price for high-ticket, reminder for the rest
Flag the payment-step drop-off to the product team with session evidence

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: incentives on carts above ₹15K need a human decision.

auto.action: Recovery journey armed for 46.8K standard carts
Payment drop-off evidence packaged for product team

gated.reason: High-ticket carts require human sign-off per your rule

actions: ₹4.1 Cr in abandoned cart value recovered
Payment flow fix shipped day 9 — abandonment normalized
outcome.lift: Nearly a third of high-ticket carts recovered — zero discounts given.

signal.headline: Direct-booking share slipped 4.1pp as OTA commissions climbed
signal.detail: Members who booked direct last year are drifting to aggregators. Every point of share shift costs roughly the margin of two properties.

plan.goal: Pull loyalty members back to direct booking before peak season pricing locks.

steps.what: Identify 27K members whose last booking moved to an aggregator
steps.expect: Drift cohort scored by trip frequency

steps.what: Configure member-only direct perks — late checkout, room upgrades over rate cuts
steps.expect: Perk bundle live on booking platform

steps.what: Compare direct-vs-OTA rebooking weekly through peak season

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: perks with per-stay cost above $18 need revenue-management sign-off.

auto.action: Drift cohort of 27,000 synced to campaign manager
Late-checkout perk configured across 74 properties

gated.action: Upgrade perk averages $24 per stay in displaced revenue

actions: Direct share recovered to within 0.9pp of last year
OTA commission spend down 11% for the cohort
outcome.lift: Direct-booking share up 3.2pp — funded by perks, not rate cuts.

signal.headline: 212,000 credit cards have gone inactive for 90+ days — annual-fee renewals hit in 8 weeks
signal.detail: Dormant-at-renewal cards cancel at 4× the base rate. The attrition exposure this cycle is the largest in three years.

plan.goal: Reactivate dormant cardholders ahead of the renewal cycle, inside compliance rules.

steps.what: Score 212K dormant cards by reactivation propensity and prior category spend
Configure category-matched spend offers; route all creative through compliance workflow
Track activation and renewal intent weekly through the cycle

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: every customer-facing offer passes compliance review before send — no exceptions.

auto.action: Propensity tiers written back to card platform
Creative submitted to compliance workflow

gated.action: Send approval for 212,000 cardholders across both offers

actions: Renewal-cycle cancellations down 27% vs projection
Full audit trail delivered to compliance — every send logged
outcome.lift: One in five dormant cards reactivated before renewal — every message compliance-cleared.

signal.headline: Prepaid churn in the East circle spiked 2.3pp after a rival's price move
signal.detail: Port-out requests cluster in high-ARPU prepaid users. The rival's offer expires in 45 days — the defense window is short.

plan.goal: Hold high-ARPU prepaid users in the East circle through the rival's offer window.

steps.what: Isolate 340K at-risk high-ARPU users by recharge decay and port-out signals
Configure tiered data bonuses matched to recharge history — richest offers only to highest risk
Track daily recharge and port-out rates against the rival's expiry date

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: retention spend above ₹2 Cr per circle needs approval.

auto.action: Defense list of 340,000 synced to campaign manager
Tier rules configured in billing

gated.action: Full defense projects ₹2.8 Cr in bonus data cost
gated.reason: Exceeds your ₹2 Cr circle spend threshold

actions: East-circle churn back to +0.4pp of baseline
Bonus data cost landed 12% under approved cap
outcome.lift: Churn spike contained within the window — high-ARPU base held.

signal.headline: Refill adherence for chronic-care members dropped 8.1pp in two months
signal.detail: The drop concentrates in members who switched to 90-day scripts. Missed refills predict both health outcomes and lifetime value.

plan.goal: Restore refill adherence for chronic-care members — carefully, and inside health-data rules.

steps.what: Identify 64K members with lapsed refills using pharmacy data only — no diagnosis inference
Configure refill reminders with pickup and delivery options; all templates through compliance
Measure adherence recovery monthly; escalate non-responders to pharmacist outreach

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: any use of health-adjacent data requires compliance review before activation.

auto.action: Privacy-safe cohort assembled — zero diagnosis fields touched
Message templates cleared by compliance workflow

gated.action: Activation of refill journeys for 64,000 members
gated.reason: Health-adjacent data — human release required by your policy

actions: Adherence recovered to within 1.8pp of baseline
Every touchpoint logged for audit — zero compliance exceptions
outcome.lift: Six of eight lost adherence points recovered — with a complete audit trail.

plan.goal: Convert fuel-only members into store shoppers without discounting fuel.

steps.what: Segment 2.1M fuel-only members by fill-up frequency and daypart
Configure at-pump offers redeemable only in-store within 15 minutes
Track attach rate and repeat store visits by cohort

campaigns.offer: Free coffee with any store purchase

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: sampling giveaways above 200K units need approval.

In-store redemption rules configured at POS

41% of converters returned within 3 weeks
outcome.lift: Fuel-to-store conversion moved 32% → 39% in the pilot cohort.

signal.detail: Service-lapsed owners are 3× less likely to repurchase the brand. Year-3 owners are the largest lapse cohort in the network's history.

plan.goal: Win back service-lapsed owners before their repurchase window opens.

Configure transparent-price service packages with pickup, matched to vehicle age
Track service bookings and repurchase-intent scores quarterly

Service capacity checked across 214 workshops

gated.reason: Requires dealer-council sign-off per your rule

signal.headline: Trial-to-paid conversion dropped 5.7pp since the last price change
signal.detail: Trialists who watch 3+ hours convert at 46%; under 1 hour, 6%. Half of new trials never reach a second session.

plan.goal: Recover trial conversion by fixing activation, not by discounting the price.

steps.what: Split 208K active trialists by watch depth and genre signals
Configure day-2 and day-7 nudges with personalized title rails per genre
Watch conversion daily by cohort; escalate price objections to plan-mix review

plan.governanceRule: Your rule: pricing or plan changes are never automated — plan-mix review is human-only.

auto.action: Watch-depth cohorts written to subscription platform
Genre rails generated for 97,000 trialists

gated.action: Premiere access grants a paid-tier entitlement early

actions: Second-session rate up 19pp in the low-activation cohort
Price held — no trial discounts introduced
outcome.lift: Most of the lost conversion recovered through activation alone.

Configure a first-transaction reward ladder with step-by-step KYC completion nudges
Track weekly transactions per user through day 30 by cohort

KYC nudge sequence configured

gated.action: First Move Bonus projects ₹1.9 Cr in cashback
gated.reason: Exceeds your ₹1.5 Cr cohort budget threshold

Cashback outlay finished 8% under the approved budget
